train_summary.json.model_td_weight_reduction: Mean of weight times elementwise Huber; no sum-of-weights division
train_summary.json.confidence_definition: Frozen native trust: tau starts1e-3 and is updated by EMA0.9tau+0.1median(error) with median floor1e-8; c=1/(1+error/tau). QDelta uses normalized Bellman target(1-gamma_delta)*log(c)+gamma_delta*(1-done)*QDelta(next), gamma_delta0.9; native weight exponentiates learned log confidence. This is distinct from passenger critic gamma1 and per-batch sum-to-one or mean-matched weights.
train_summary.json.comparison_boundary: Matched comparison against existing V-only75k changes only actor free-state multiplier. Removing the multiplier changes actor gradient direction and total strength; this identifies the overall masking rule, not supervision anchoring separately. Stage55k differs in update count and scheduling recipe.
train_summary.json.interpretation: One-variable actor masking diagnostic on already analyzed Halifax72571-72573 cases. Only comparison with matched masked V-only75k isolates this intervention. Keep all seeds and days; no prospective/population claim, no confidence-module attribution or claim that masking is a bug.
